note: Shared Word web topics for every level. Each topic lists words from any level; a level shows only its own words (topics with fewer than 3 are hidden unless they are a word's only home). sentences: level -> a sentence using only that level's and earlier words; a level without its own sentence uses the nearest lower one. Order and groups here are the order and groups on screen.

1.zh: 你好！谢谢你，再见！
1.en: Hello! Thank you, goodbye!

2.zh: 不好意思，请问洗手间在哪儿？
2.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

4.zh: 我向老师道歉，老师原谅了我。
4.en: I apologised to the teacher, and the teacher kindly forgave me.

5.zh: 恭喜！我们握手告别，一路顺风！
5.en: Congratulations! We shake hands and say goodbye. Have a good trip!

1.zh: 他是我的朋友，她是我的同学，我们都很好。
1.en: He is my friend, she is my classmate, and we are all well.

2.zh: 我自己做饭，大家都说好吃。
2.en: I cook for myself, and everyone says it is tasty.

3.zh: 咱们一起去吧，别的同学已经走了。
3.en: Let us go together; the other students have already left.

4.zh: 各位同学，任何问题都可以问我。
4.en: Everyone, you can ask me any question.

5.zh: 我们各自有工作，但彼此常常联系。
5.en: We each have our own work, but we often keep in touch with each other.

1.zh: 这个很好，那个太贵了。
1.en: This one is good; that one is too expensive.

2.zh: 今天这里人这么多！
2.en: There are so many people here today!

4.zh: 我家对面有一个公园，公园周围有很多树。
4.en: There is a park opposite my home, and there are many trees around it.

5.zh: 如下就是当地的规定。
5.en: The following is the local rule.

1.zh: 你叫什么名字？你住在哪儿？
1.en: What is your name? Where do you live?

2.zh: 你今天为什么不去学校？
2.en: Why aren't you going to school today?

4.zh: 你到底想去哪儿？
4.en: Where on earth do you want to go?

1.zh: 我家有三口人，他八岁，她十岁。
1.en: There are three people in my family; he is eight and she is ten.

2.zh: 这个手机一万块，太贵了。
2.en: This phone costs ten thousand yuan; that is too expensive.

4.zh: 这个班有二十个学生，多数是女生。
4.en: There are twenty students in this class, and most of them are girls.

5.zh: 这个城市的人口将近一亿。
5.en: The population of this city is nearly one hundred million.

1.zh: 你有多少钱？我有一点儿。
1.en: How much money do you have? I have a little.

2.zh: 每个人都有一些书。
2.en: Everyone has some books.

3.zh: 这里来了好多人，一共有一百个，几乎都是学生。
3.en: Lots of people have come here, a hundred in all, and almost all of them are students.

4.zh: 我的钱不够，只买了一部分。
4.en: My money is not enough, so I only bought part of it.

5.zh: 大批游客来到这里，这里足够热闹。
5.en: A large number of tourists come here, so it is lively enough.

4.zh: 我们的钱不够，只剩一百块了。
4.en: We do not have enough money; there are only a hundred yuan left.

4.zh: 全部的学生都来了，整个教室都满了。
4.en: All the students have come, and the whole classroom is full.

1.zh: 我买了三本书、两件衣服和一个苹果。
1.en: I bought three books, two items of clothing and an apple.

2.zh: 这位老师有两条狗和一只猫。
2.en: This teacher has two dogs and a cat.

3.zh: 我买了一双新鞋，也给朋友写了一封信。
3.en: I bought a pair of new shoes and also wrote a letter to a friend.

4.zh: 我昨天看了一部电影，吃了一顿很好的饭。
4.en: Yesterday I watched a film and had a very good meal.

5.zh: 他送了我一束花、一套书和一副手套。
5.en: He gave me a bunch of flowers, a set of books and a pair of gloves.

3.zh: 一个苹果三毛，我买了两个。
3.en: One apple costs three mao, and I bought two.

4.zh: 他每天跑五公里，体重已经减了两千克。
4.en: He runs five kilometres every day, and he has already lost two kilograms.

5.zh: 这把尺子长三十厘米。
5.en: This ruler is thirty centimetres long.

1.zh: 我叫小明，认识你很高兴。
1.en: My name is Xiaoming; nice to meet you.

2.zh: 我来介绍一下，这是我的朋友，他叫小明。
2.en: Let me introduce my friend; his name is Xiaoming.

4.zh: 请填写你的年龄和国籍。
4.en: Please fill in your age and nationality.

5.zh: 请在这里签名，再写上你的住址。
5.en: Please sign here and write down your address.

1.zh: 这个人是我的朋友，那个小朋友是他的孩子。
1.en: This person is my friend, and that child is his child.

2.zh: 这个男孩儿是我的同学，那个女孩儿是我的朋友。
2.en: This boy is my classmate and that girl is my friend.

3.zh: 阿姨和叔叔是我爸爸妈妈的朋友。
3.en: Auntie and Uncle are friends of my mum and dad.

4.zh: 这位歌手和那位演员都是我喜欢的。
4.en: This singer and that actor are both people I like.

5.zh: 路人都看着那位新娘和新郎。
5.en: The passers-by are all looking at the bride and groom.

3.zh: 我的邻居很热情，常常请同事来家里玩。
3.en: My neighbour is very friendly and often invites colleagues to visit.

4.zh: 房东叫师傅来修我家的窗户。
4.en: The landlord told the repairman to come and fix the window of my home.

5.zh: 物业和居民一起接待嘉宾。
5.en: The property management and the residents receive the guests together.

1.zh: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、姐姐和我。
1.en: There are five people in my family: dad, mom, older brother, older sister and me.

2.zh: 我爷爷奶奶住在我家，他们身体很好。
2.en: My grandparents live in our home; they are in good health.

3.zh: 他们是夫妻，她的姐妹也住在这个城市。
3.en: They are husband and wife, and her sisters also live in this city.

4.zh: 我父母的老家在农村，亲戚很多。
4.en: My parents' old home is in the countryside, and there are many relatives.

5.zh: 姥姥和姥爷很爱他们的儿女。
5.en: Grandma and Grandpa love their children very much.

5.zh: 他们恋爱三年，今年举行婚礼。
5.en: They have been in love for three years and are having their wedding this year.

1.zh: 我女儿八岁，她是小学生。
1.en: My daughter is eight; she is a primary-school student.

2.zh: 我小时候住在中国，从小就喜欢吃饺子。
2.en: I lived in China when I was little, and I have liked dumplings since I was a child.

3.zh: 他很年轻，二十五岁就结婚了，还养了一只狗。
3.en: He is young: he got married at twenty-five and also keeps a dog.

4.zh: 他从童年开始，就爱唱歌。
4.en: He has loved singing since childhood.

5.zh: 孩子在幼儿园长大，成熟得很快。
5.en: The child grows up in kindergarten and matures quickly.

1.zh: 我在公司工作，今天很忙。
1.en: I work at a company, and I am busy today.

2.zh: 我哥哥是医生，今天他上班很忙。
2.en: My older brother is a doctor, and he is busy at work today.

3.zh: 经理在办公室开会，司机在外面等他。
3.en: The manager is having a meeting in the office, and the driver is waiting for him outside.

4.zh: 大夫和护士都很辛苦。
4.en: The doctor and the nurse both work very hard.

5.zh: 她是一名工程师，现在担任部门主任。
5.en: She is an engineer and now serves as department director.

4.zh: 我哥哥是律师，我姐姐是护士。
4.en: My older brother is a lawyer, and my older sister is a nurse.

5.zh: 他是一名工程师，他的妻子是秘书。
5.en: He is an engineer, and his wife is a secretary.

4.zh: 他去一家公司应聘，明天要面试。
4.en: He is applying for a job at a company and will have an interview tomorrow.

5.zh: 她辞职以后自己创业了。
5.en: After she resigned, she started her own business.

4.zh: 他每天加班，工资也不高。
4.en: He works overtime every day, and the pay is not high either.

5.zh: 公司和客户签订了新合同。
5.en: The company signed a new contract with a client.

4.zh: 他经常加班，可是工资不高。
4.en: He often works overtime, but his wages are not high.

1.zh: 今天是四月五日，明天是星期天。
1.en: Today is April 5th, and tomorrow is Sunday.

2.zh: 下个星期五是我的生日。
2.en: Next Friday is my birthday.

3.zh: 工作日我很忙，周末才有时间。
3.en: On weekdays I am busy, and only at the weekend do I have time.

4.zh: 我们的期末考试在一月的最后一个星期。
4.en: Our end-of-term exam is in the last week of January.

5.zh: 年初和年底，我们都很忙。
5.en: At the beginning and the end of the year we are all very busy.

3.zh: 一年有四季：春天、夏天、秋天和冬天。
3.en: A year has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

4.zh: 暑假很热，寒假很冷。
4.en: Summer vacation is hot and winter vacation is cold.

3.zh: 学校放假了，我们回家过节。
3.en: School has closed for the holiday, so we are going home to celebrate the festival.

4.zh: 节假日里，朋友们常常聚会。
4.en: On holidays, friends often get together.

5.zh: 除夕，我们一家人一起吃年夜饭。
5.en: On New Year's Eve, our whole family has the big dinner together.

1.zh: 现在几点？现在是七点半。
1.en: What time is it? It is half past seven.

2.zh: 请等一会儿，现在是下午三点十分。
2.en: Please wait a moment; it is ten past three in the afternoon.

4.zh: 我早晨七点吃早餐，晚上八点吃晚餐。
4.en: I eat breakfast at seven in the morning and dinner at eight in the evening.

5.zh: 他常常熬夜，半夜才睡觉。
5.en: He often stays up late and only goes to bed at midnight.

3.zh: 火车晚点了，我们等了半天，所以迟到了。
3.en: The train was late, we waited for ages, and so we were late ourselves.

4.zh: 快一点，我们还来得及赶上火车。
4.en: Hurry up; we are still in time to catch the train.

5.zh: 这次活动将持续很长时间。
5.en: This event will continue for a long time.

1.zh: 你在做什么？我正在看电视。
1.en: What are you doing? I am watching TV.

2.zh: 我已经吃饭了，你经常在这里吃饭吗？
2.en: I have already eaten; do you often eat here?

3.zh: 我平时六点起床，今天八点才起床。
3.en: I usually get up at six, but today I only got up at eight.

4.zh: 我偶尔去看电影，但是从来不迟到。
4.en: I go to the cinema now and then, but I am never late.

5.zh: 他从不迟到，通常来得很早。
5.en: He never arrives late and usually comes very early.

3.zh: 我刚到家，雨突然下大了。
3.en: I had just got home when it suddenly started to rain hard.

4.zh: 之前我很忙，之后就轻松多了。
4.en: Before, I was busy; after that it was much easier.

5.zh: 此前我没见过他，此后我们常常见面。
5.en: I had not met him before this; after this we often meet.

topics.name: Food and meals
topics.cta: Use these when you order food or drinks

1.zh: 我早饭吃面包，午饭吃米饭，晚饭吃饺子。
1.en: I eat bread for breakfast, rice for lunch and dumplings for dinner.

2.zh: 这家饭馆的鱼很好吃，我们去吃吧。
2.en: The fish at this restaurant is very tasty; let us go and eat.

3.zh: 我饿了，请给我菜单，我想尝一尝这个菜。
3.en: I am hungry now. Please give me the menu, because I want to try this dish.

4.zh: 我喜欢在食堂吃午餐，那里的菜味道不错。
4.en: I like to eat lunch in the canteen; the taste there is good.

5.zh: 他最喜欢火锅，我喜欢西餐。
5.en: He likes hot pot best, and I like Western food.

3.zh: 夏天我喜欢吃西瓜和冰激凌，很甜也很凉快。
3.en: In summer I like eating watermelon and ice cream; they are sweet and cool.

1.zh: 苹果是我最喜欢的水果。
1.en: Apples are my favourite fruit.

4.zh: 我爱吃葡萄和饼干，也爱吃巧克力。
4.en: I love eating grapes and biscuits, and I also love chocolate.

5.zh: 橘子和梨都很甜，雪糕更甜。
5.en: Tangerines and pears are both very sweet, and ice lollies are even sweeter.

5.zh: 先把番茄切好，再炒一下。
5.en: First cut the tomato well, then stir-fry it.

topics.name: Drinks
topics.cta: Use these when you order food or drinks

1.zh: 我喝茶，他喝牛奶，你喝水吗？
1.en: I drink tea, he drinks milk; do you drink water?

2.zh: 我喝咖啡，她喝奶茶，他们喝红茶。
2.en: I drink coffee, she drinks milk tea and they drink black tea.

3.zh: 我很渴，想喝一杯冰的饮料。
3.en: I am very thirsty and want a cold drink with ice.

4.zh: 朋友们喝着葡萄酒，一起干杯。
4.en: The friends drink wine and cheer together.

5.zh: 她喝了一杯豆浆，不喝酒。
5.en: She drank a cup of soy milk and does not drink alcohol.

3.zh: 请给我一个碗和一双筷子。
3.en: Please give me a bowl and a pair of chopsticks.

1.zh: 请给我一个杯子。
1.en: Please give me a cup.

4.zh: 盒子里有一把刀，还有两个袋子。
4.en: In the box there is a knife, and there are also two bags.

5.zh: 把锅里的汤倒进盆里。
5.en: Pour the soup in the pot into the basin.

topics.name: Money and shopping
topics.cta: Use these when you ask a price

1.zh: 这件衣服多少钱？太贵了，我想买便宜的。
1.en: How much is this piece of clothing? It is too expensive; I want to buy a cheaper one.

2.zh: 商场里的东西很贵，超市的便宜一点儿。
2.en: Things in the mall are expensive; the supermarket's are a little cheaper.

3.zh: 我没有带银行卡，可以用信用卡吗？
3.en: I did not bring my bank card. Can I use a credit card?

4.zh: 这家商店打折，价格很低，我买了很多东西。
4.en: This shop has a sale and the prices are low, so I bought a lot of things.

5.zh: 今天有折扣，也有优惠，东西便宜很多。
5.en: Today there are discounts and special offers, so things are much cheaper.

topics.name: Prices and paying
topics.cta: Use these when you ask a price

4.zh: 这件衣服在打折，价格很便宜。
4.en: This piece of clothing is on sale, and the price is very cheap.

5.zh: 最近物价上涨了，很多东西都涨价了。
5.en: Prices have risen recently, and many things have gone up.

topics.name: Earning and saving
topics.cta: Use these when you ask a price

4.zh: 他的工资不高，可是他很会节约。
4.en: His wages are not high, but he is very good at saving.

topics.name: Online shopping and delivery
topics.cta: Use these when you ask a price

4.zh: 现在很多人喜欢网购。
4.en: Now many people like to shop online.

5.zh: 我在网上买了一个二手电脑，运费是商家付的。
5.en: I bought a second-hand computer online, and the seller paid for the delivery.

1.zh: 这件衣服很好看，你想穿吗？
1.en: This piece of clothing is pretty; do you want to wear it?

2.zh: 这条裤子和这个包都很好看。
2.en: These trousers and this bag are both pretty.

3.zh: 天气热，我穿衬衫和短裤。
3.en: It is hot, so I am wearing a shirt and shorts.

4.zh: 他戴上帽子和眼镜，穿上了毛衣。
4.en: He put on a hat and glasses and put on a sweater.

5.zh: 他穿西装，戴领带，还戴手套。
5.en: He wears a suit, a tie and gloves.

topics.name: Places around town
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 我去商店买东西，也去书店看书。
1.en: I go to the shop to buy things, and I also go to the bookstore to read.

2.zh: 机场离酒店很远，我们坐地铁去。
2.en: The airport is far from the hotel; we go by subway.

3.zh: 图书馆在公园旁边，银行在体育馆后面。
3.en: The library is next to the park, and the bank is behind the gym.

4.zh: 剧院在市区，工厂在郊区。
4.en: The theatre is in the urban area, and the factory is in the suburbs.

5.zh: 博物馆和邮局都在广场旁边。
5.en: The museum and the post office are both next to the square.

3.zh: 这个城市很大，我家小区附近的环境很好。
3.en: This city is very big, and the surroundings near my neighbourhood are very nice.

4.zh: 这个城市的街道很干净，人也很友好。
4.en: The streets of this city are very clean, and the people are friendly too.

5.zh: 这个社区在城区，离地铁站很近。
5.en: This community is in the urban area, very close to the subway station.

topics.name: Directions and positions
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 你的书在桌子上，我的手机在这里。
1.en: Your book is on the table, and my phone is here.

2.zh: 学校在左边，医院在右边，超市在前面。
2.en: The school is on the left, the hospital is on the right, and the supermarket is ahead.

3.zh: 我家在公园和学校中间，附近到处都是树。
3.en: My home is between the park and the school, and there are trees everywhere nearby.

5.zh: 书架在房间内部，靠近窗台。
5.en: The bookshelf is inside the room, close to the windowsill.

topics.name: Near, along and around
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

5.zh: 我家靠近公园，顺着这条路一直走就到了。
5.en: My home is near the park; just keep walking along this road and you will arrive.

3.zh: 中国的北方很冷，南方很热。
3.en: The north of China is cold and the south is hot.

4.zh: 北部很冷，南部很暖和，西部有很多山。
4.en: The north is cold, the south is warm, and the west has many mountains.

1.zh: 我今天去学校，明天回家。
1.en: I go to school today and go home tomorrow.

2.zh: 你进来吧，我出去一下就回来。
2.en: Come in; I will go out for a moment and be right back.

3.zh: 我们八点出发，经过公园，离开这个城市。
3.en: We set off at eight, go past the park and leave this city.

5.zh: 他前往机场，一路上没有堵车。
5.en: He goes to the airport and there is no traffic jam all the way.

topics.name: Roads and distance
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 学校离我家很近，走路十分钟就到了。
1.en: The school is very near my home; it takes ten minutes on foot.

2.zh: 学校离我家很近，走路十分钟就到了。
2.en: The school is very near my home; it takes ten minutes on foot.

3.zh: 过马路的时候，请看红绿灯。
3.en: When you cross the road, please look at the traffic light.

4.zh: 高速公路上堵车了，距离不远，但是很慢。
4.en: There is a traffic jam on the highway now; the distance is not far, but it is slow.

5.zh: 这条铁路的路线很长，行程要两天。
5.en: This railway route is very long, and the journey takes two days.

topics.name: Transport and tickets
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 我坐出租车去，你坐火车去。
1.en: I go by taxi, and you go by train.

2.zh: 我坐地铁去机场，你坐公交车去车站。
2.en: I take the subway to the airport, and you take the bus to the station.

3.zh: 我骑自行车去，你坐高铁去。
3.en: I will go by bicycle, and you go by high-speed train.

4.zh: 乘客们都在排队等大巴。
4.en: The passengers are all queuing for the coach.

5.zh: 他有驾照，但是车祸后不再驾驶。
5.en: He has a driving licence, but after the car accident he no longer drives.

1.zh: 我想去中国玩，你呢？
1.en: I want to go and have fun in China; what about you?

2.zh: 我想出国旅游，已经买了机票。
2.en: I want to travel abroad, and I have already bought the plane ticket.

3.zh: 出国要带护照，也要带好行李。
3.en: To go abroad you need to bring your passport and pack your luggage well.

4.zh: 我们去旅行，参观了很多景点。
4.en: We went travelling and visited many scenic spots.

5.zh: 旅行社安排我们去欧洲游览。
5.en: The travel agency arranges for us to tour Europe.

1.zh: 我家有三个房间，桌子和椅子在大房间里。
1.en: My home has three rooms; the table and chairs are in the big room.

2.zh: 我家在三楼，洗手间在门口旁边。
2.en: My home is on the third floor, and the restroom is next to the doorway.

3.zh: 我们搬家了，新房子在十二层，有电梯。
3.en: We have moved house; the new home is on the 12th floor and has an elevator.
